title: UFO Moviez Partners DCDC to Expand Indian Cinema in North America
description: UFO Moviez India Limited has announced a strategic partnership with Digital Cinema Distribution Coalition (DCDC) to facilitate the distribution of Indian feature films across North America. This collaboration aims to expand the global reach of Indian cinema by enabling faster, more secure, and seamless digital delivery of films to exhibitors. By combining UFO Moviez's relationships with Indian filmmakers and DCDC's digital cinema delivery network, the partnership simplifies the process for bringing a wider range of Indian films to new audiences in the U.S. and Canada. The companies have already seen success with 'Bandar' and plan to collaborate on future releases like 'The Indian Story'.
